tagline: Print it. Ship it. Own it.
brief: Print-on-demand for online shops: upload a design, list it on TikTok Shop, Shopee or Shopify, and printexo prints and ships every order. exo means connecting: printexo is the joint between the shop, the print floor and the customer.
criteria: Success: an abstract symbol for connecting, built from the brand's one 30° blade angle, that works at 16 px, in one colour and next to the existing custom wordmark.

concepts.name: printexo v3 · Dovetail
concepts.idea: Two halves of a square locked by a tail that flares at the 30° blade angle: a joint that holds without glue.
rationale: Says connecting without drawing an object: exo is the joint
Built from the same 30° blade as the wordmark, so symbol and lettering read as one system
A solid square, so it is the strongest possible app icon and favicon; the Lime tail marks the connection

recommendation: Roll out v3 across the site, app icon, packaging and merch, with the Lime-tail duo on Deep Green as the signature.
next_steps: Print proof of Lime (match a Pantone swatch)
Professional trademark search for the dovetail symbol
Update social avatars and marketplace shop logos
